name: netfly-sports-platform
description: Netfly Sports Betting Platform - Full-stack sportsbook with simulated live matches

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run setup && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:frontend
